title: Heaven: Would A Good Person Even Want To Go? #shorts

top_liked.author: @ChixieMary
top_liked.text:
Some of us have been saying for decades that the Christian version of heaven sounds like hell to a lot of us. 
It's a celestial North Korea.
Why would anyone want that for eternity?
